data.define: Used when you don't know the answer.

misuse.text: Don't say 'beats me' to a client's question.

data.l1: मुझे नहीं पता; मुझे क्या पता

native.tip: “beats me” = मुझे नहीं पता; मुझे क्या पता. उदाहरण: “Where's the key? Beats me.”
